data.one_liner: Widget for selecting an integer via buttons or a textfield
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable UI for choosing an integer value. It supports increment/decrement buttons, skip to first/last, ESC cancel, Enter update, and negative numbers.
use_when: Replacing a plain TextField for integer entry
avoid_when: Complex validation logic that requires custom validators
strengths: Debounced input and non-nullable update delay
weaknesses: No built-in validation or formatting beyond integers
